findings.claim: Native EfVT=7 selector joins to the radial loader fragment 0x1403abb25 in enclosing function 0x1403ab860.
evidence: EfVT tag comparison 0x1403ab8f9; byte load/store at 0x1403ab919/0x1403ab91e into outer +4
Data comparison 0x1403ab8f2; signed byte selector at 0x1403ab926; unsigned range check <=9; image-relative table jump at 0x1403ab934..0x1403ab93f
Table 0x1403ac2f0[7]=0x003abb25; R11 image base from 0x1403ab896
Unwind 0x1426111c0 CHAININFO points to 0x1403ab860..0x1403ab892
limitations: Assumes valid source ordering: EfVT before Data, as in pinned original; no dynamic execution or complete outer caller chain proven.

findings.claim: Allocated radial Data is 0x38 bytes; outer object +0x10 receives its 8-byte pointer. Curve slots Len/Str/Gra/IRad/ORad are 8-byte pointer storage at +0/+8/+0x10/+0x18/+0x20.
evidence: 0x1403abb99..0x1403abbcc allocates via context +0x14/+8 and initializes block; 0x1403abb30 stores outer pointer
0x1403abbed, 0x1403abbd1, 0x1403abc08, 0x1403abc30, 0x1403abc2a form slot addresses for common helper 0x140396660
Helper 0x1403967e3..0x1403967f5 forms allocated curve address; 0x14039685d..0x140396862 writes an 8-byte pointer to caller slot
limitations: Size-count branch at 0x1403abb25 increments context +0x18 and writes null outer data pointer; it is not the materialized curve initialization path.

findings.claim: Absent IRad retains non-null shared pointer 0x142aa7d78 at radial +0x18 on the materializing path; it is neither a null curve pointer nor a proven numeric zero.
evidence: R10 is defined by LEA at 0x1403ab8a1 and restored each outer iteration at 0x1403abacb, both to 0x142aa7d78
Data selector reaches initialization without an intervening call; 0x1403abbb5 stores R10 at +0x18
Only matching IRad branch 0x1403abc1c..0x1403abc34 sends +0x18 to helper; absent tag skips it
All five curve slots initially receive that same address
limitations: Global lies in virtual-only .data; its runtime contents/initializers and first post-load consumer are unresolved. The PE virtual zero-fill does not establish an evaluated radius. No numeric IRad default or render fallback is proven.

findings.claim: The common curve loader preserves an existing slot when no new curve allocation is produced, then dereferences that curve header; this is loader behavior, not the missing-IRad render consumer.
evidence: 0x14039682c..0x14039686f chooses newly allocated R10 or reloads qword [slot], then reads dword [R10]
0x140396891..0x1403968cd derives key count from header and updates bits 7/8 for zero/one/multiple keys
limitations: The absent IRad tag never calls this helper for that slot. Header handling does not reveal the sampling/evaluation default or shader formula.

findings.claim: FSDc/FEDc are 4-byte fields at +0x28/+0x2c initialized to float bit patterns 50.0/75.0; FaBP is a 4-byte destination at +0x30 initialized to zero but loaded with signed-byte extension.
evidence: 0x1403abbbd stores 0x42480000 to +0x28; 0x1403abbc4 stores qword 0x0000000042960000 covering +0x2c and +0x30
FSDc 0x1403abc0e..0x1403abc10 and FEDc 0x1403abb8f..0x1403abb91 copy dwords
FaBP 0x1403abc36 movsx eax, byte ptr [rbx]; 0x1403abc39 mov dword ptr [rsi+0x30], eax
limitations: Serialized FaBP in original is four bytes; descriptor reads signed i32. Native load is signed i8 to i32. Current zero sample cannot prove equivalence for nonzero/high-byte cases.

findings.claim: Pinned original has EfVT 07000000, Len/Str/Gra/ORad and no IRad; FaBP is four zero bytes. Upstream schema explicitly maps RadialBlur=7 and names all eight fields.
evidence: Original SHA256 3719a1cfcb102a31469770f53aca9b8edd8ec84bb490c645dbc080a1c7487201
Private e483c3c5-df20-4667-b704-776a5c5c94c1/original-radial.json records field lengths and hashes
Frozen Enums.cs, AvfxEffector.cs and AvfxEffectorDataRadialBlur.cs pins verified; source helper and original action read unchanged
limitations: Upstream naming supports interpretation; actual native selector proof comes from binary table. Named RadialBlur strings were not used as semantic evidence.

findings.claim: 0x142aa7d78 is a shared default/empty curve object.
evidence: Same non-null address seeds all five pointer slots; common helper can preserve and dereference existing storage.
limitations: Empty/default semantic identity and evaluated number require its initializer and runtime evaluator; not established by its virtual zero-fill address.

open_questions: Which runtime instruction first reads radial Data +0x18 from the outer +0x10 pointer, and what does its evaluator return for the shared 0x142aa7d78 curve? No bounded direct reference to that consumer was obtained; reverse-reference scanning was not attempted.
Which initializer writes 0x142aa7d78 before this loading path? Is its curve header/key storage modified before consumption?
After that evaluator, which host parameter receives IRad, and what radius normalization/fade/projection formula uses it? Establish only that handoff before considering shader work.
